name: Metrocrest Services Food Pantry
hoursNotes: Shopping is by scheduled appointment — call or email intake@metrocrestservices.org.
requirements: Appointment required. Serves residents of Carrollton, Addison, Farmers Branch, Coppell, and the Dallas portion of 75287 in Denton County.
notes: Grocery-style choice pantry with milk, bread, meat, produce, and hygiene supplies. Also provides rent/utility assistance, senior services, and home-delivered meals.
